instructions: Every PR description in this repository carries a 'Runtime evidence (Garnet)' section between <!-- garnet:evidence:begin --> and <!-- garnet:evidence:end -->: a verbatim, head-bound mirror of the kernel-recorded execution record (process chains and the outbound destinations each chain reached) for the PR head. Follow REVIEW.md at the repo root. In short: (1) only use the record if its <!-- garnet:commit <sha> --> marker equals the PR head SHA — otherwise treat evidence as pending, never stale-ground; (2) the factual primitive is the execution chain (process lineage → destination, per workflow/job) — do not reduce it to loose action labels; (3) in a diff-fenced comparison, '+' lines are chains/destinations new versus the previous profiled commit — the strongest divergence signal — and '-' lines are history; (4) never repeat verdicts, scores, severities, or baseline judgments from any tool — re-derive relevance from the code diff; (5) cite every record-grounded finding exactly as: Runtime evidence (Garnet, head <sha7>): <process lineage> → <destination> (<workflow>/<job>) — <Execution Profile URL>; (6) a missing or pending record means no runtime evidence, not a clean run.
